title: Postfix deferred queue is growing
description: Postfix deferred queue on {dims:host.name} is above threshold. Check log.postfix.delivery by relay_host and the deferred reasons (dsn/reason) in logs.

input.value: timeseries deferred = max(log.postfix.queue.messages), interval:1m, by:{dt.entity.host, host.name}, filter:{postfix.queue == "deferred"}

properties.value: Postfix deferred queue on {dims:host.name} is above threshold. Check log.postfix.delivery by relay_host and the deferred reasons (dsn/reason) in logs.
